title: Task (wire)
description: A task as it appears in command replies and webhook events (taskToWire). This is not the on-device storage format: for the full export see export.schema.json, $defs/Task.

id.description: Task id. Use it with complete_task, either in full or as a unique prefix.

description.description: Present only when the task has a description.

start.description: Start time, HH:MM. Present only for timed tasks.

end.description: End time, HH:MM. Present only when the task has one.

done.description: true when the task is completed (for a counter or a checklist: when it reaches the target).
